boundary_conditions: dT_dx(0) = -(cavity_convective_coefficient*(T_air + air_heating_fraction*cladding_solar_absorptance*solar_irradiance/(outer_heat_transfer_coefficient + 2*cavity_convective_coefficient + cavity_radiative_coefficient) - T(0)) + cavity_radiative_coefficient*(T_air + cladding_solar_absorptance*solar_irradiance/(outer_heat_transfer_coefficient + 2*cavity_convective_coefficient + cavity_radiative_coefficient) - T(0)) + wall_direct_solar_absorptance*solar_irradiance - wall_longwave_loss)/wall_conductance

parameters.name: wall_conductance
parameters.justification: Conductance of wall/roof layers plus inner film, 1/(1/U - 1/h_o) for U=0.5 W/m2K and h_o=20 W/m2K; x normalised over the wall thickness.

parameters.name: T_air
parameters.justification: Daytime mean summer air temperature 38 C.

parameters.name: cavity_convective_coefficient
parameters.justification: Forced/mixed convection in a 6 cm cavity at 0.4 m/s.

parameters.name: air_heating_fraction
parameters.justification: Mean cavity air excess as a fraction of the cladding excess for NTU ~3-4.

parameters.name: wall_direct_solar_absorptance
parameters.justification: Wall behind the cladding receives no direct sun.

parameters.name: wall_longwave_loss
parameters.justification: Wall behind the cladding has no sky view.
